title: Homeowner Service Contracts Premium Pricing Rule: Monthly Installments and Annual Premium
content:
**Rule.** The monthly installment for a tier of Homeowner Service Contracts equals the tier's base monthly premium,
- plus the lower-fee monthly surcharge when the contract's service call fee equals the lower fee option,
- less the higher-fee monthly discount when it equals the higher fee option,
- plus the oversize-home monthly surcharge when the square footage is at or above the oversize-home threshold,
- less the condominium or townhome monthly discount when the property type is condominium or townhome.

The adjustments are flat amounts added together, never compounded. Each figure is the tier's own rate on the Homeowner Service Contracts rate schedule for the tier held.

**Monthly billing.** A monthly-billed contract is charged one monthly installment per billing period. Each billing period starts on the same calendar day of the month as the term start date (the last day of the month when that day does not exist), and the installment is due on the period start.

**Annual billing.** An annual-billed contract is charged one annual premium per term on the term start date, equal to twelve monthly installments reduced by the annual pay-in-full discount and rounded to the cent.

**Renewal terms.** Renewal and late-renewal terms are priced with the tier parameters in force on the new term start date for the tier held for that term.

**Returned payments.** A returned premium payment is billed back as a returned-payment charge equal to the returned amount, together with one returned payment fee charge of the tier's returned payment fee, both carrying the confirmation number of the returned payment.

**When premium is billed.** Premium is billed only while the contract status is waiting period, active or suspended for nonpayment. No premium is billed for any period after a contract's end date. The status is read from the contract record before any charge.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A Bridgewell HomeCare Silver contract with the lower 100.00 fee option on a 5,200-square-foot townhome, using the Silver rates (base 62.99, lower-fee surcharge 8.00, oversize surcharge 14.00 at a 5000-square-foot threshold, townhome discount 5.00):

1. Base monthly premium: 62.99.
2. Add the lower-fee surcharge: 62.99 plus 8.00 gives 70.99.
3. 5,200 square feet is at or above the threshold, so add 14.00: 84.99.
4. Townhome, so take off 5.00: 79.99 is the monthly installment.
5. Annual premium: twelve installments are 959.88; reduced by a 10% discount this is 863.892, rounded to the cent 863.89.

Because the adjustments are flat amounts, the discount and the surcharges each act on nothing but themselves; none is a percentage of another.

## Points of judgement

| Fact on the contract | Effect on the monthly installment |
|---|---|
| Standard fee option elected | no fee-option adjustment |
| Square footage one foot below the threshold | no oversize surcharge |
| Single-family or mobile home | no condominium or townhome discount |
| Contract cancelled, period after its end date | no premium billed |
